'''Becky Higgerson''' is a Decipherian; the card title [[Kebyc]] is an anagram of her name.<ref name="ana">[https://www.geocities.ws/plarathas/anagrams.html Anagramed Decipherians], geocities.ws. Copied in [https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], p. 200.</ref>

== Jedi Knights TCG ==
Higgerson is credited on Decipher's [[Jedi Knights Trading Card Game]] team (2001).<ref name="jkrules">[http://www.decipher.com/jediknights/rules/jediknightsrules.txt ''Jedi Knights'' Trading Card Game rulebook (credits)], Decipher (2001). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010820125115/http://www.decipher.com:80/jediknights/rules/jediknightsrules.txt Internet Archive]</ref>
